title: Really pretty and cute cups, but there are too few in package.
text: Really pretty and cute cups, but there are too few in package.. They come precisely as pictured look so cute and small perfect for a little get together or a small party/reunion, or you can just buy more for a bigger party. Overall they are perfect for I'd say a unicorn themed party or maybe futuristic as well :) I like them a lot so cute and lovely <3 Will probably get more in the future.
